purpose: Phase 3 — Moderate Advisory Disposition (Task 3). Documents the disposition of every residual npm audit advisory after W2. Pre-W2 baseline: 1 critical, 3 high, 14 moderate. Post-W2: 0 critical, 0 high, 14 moderate (all residual are transitive). W3 must record every one of the 14 moderate advisories with a disposition (resolved, deferred, accepted, or rejected). The w3 Red-phase TDD suite asserts (a) this fixture exists, (b) it carries the schema_version, advisories array, and drizzle_kit_floor fields, (c) every advisory has severity/title/package/disposition, and (d) the drizzle-kit downgrade guard (FR9) holds. Green behavior: a w3 Green commit produces one row per advisory with evidence (deferral owner, follow-up wave, or `accepted` with exploitability analysis).

drizzle_kit_floor.rationale: spec FR9 / AC2 forbids accepting `npm audit fix --force` recommendations to downgrade drizzle-kit to 0.18.1. The 0.31.10 floor in apps/bus-math-v2 is the pre-W2 baseline; the audit suggestion is unsafe because the older 0.18.x line re-introduces known issues. drizzle-kit advisories must be dispositioned as `rejected` (downgrade not accepted) or `deferred` to a future track that ships a proper 0.31.x+ fix.

disposition_taxonomy.resolved: A manifest, lockfile, or peer-bump landed in W3 that removed the advisory path.
disposition_taxonomy.deferred: The advisory persists; owner and follow-up wave are recorded. Deferred rows must be revisited by their owner before P5 closure.
disposition_taxonomy.accepted: The advisory is exploitable only in unreachable code paths; a written exploitability analysis is required in the row.
disposition_taxonomy.rejected: The advisory recommends a downgrade or workaround forbidden by spec NFR (e.g., FR9 for drizzle-kit). Rejected rows are NOT auto-fixed; they remain in the audit report and are attributed to the wave that flagged them.

advisories.title: npm audit suggests downgrading drizzle-kit to 0.18.1
advisories.follow_up_action: Do NOT downgrade. FR9 / AC2 explicitly forbids the recommended downgrade. Watch the drizzle-kit GitHub releases for a 0.31.10+ fix; the floor at ^0.31.10 is preserved.
advisories.evidence: spec FR9: 'do not downgrade drizzle-kit to 0.18.1 merely because npm audit proposes it; document exploitability, upstream status, and the chosen resolution.' exploitability: the 0.18.1 downgrade re-introduces known migration bugs in drizzle-kit's schema-diff path and is not operationally acceptable. upstream status: drizzle-kit has not released a 0.31.10+ fix as of 2026-06-07. chosen resolution: REJECT the audit recommendation; keep ^0.31.10 and revisit when upstream ships a 0.31.x+ patch.
